name: How much should a luxury home remodel cost in Los Angeles by room and finish level?

mainEntity.name: How much should a high-end home remodel cost in Los Angeles by room and finish level?
mainEntity.text: How much should a high-end home remodel cost in Los Angeles by room and finish level?

acceptedAnswer.text: A high-end remodel in Los Angeles should be budgeted by scope, not by square foot alone. Finish level, structural changes, custom cabinetry, stone selection, appliance packages, and MEP upgrades can change the total dramatically. A kitchen may cost far less than a full-home renovation with new systems, windows, and layout reconfiguration. Homeowners should ask for an itemized estimate that separates design, demolition, framing, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, finishes, and allowances for fixtures and appliances. Luxury projects also need a contingency for concealed conditions, especially in older homes common in Pasadena, Glendale, and Los Angeles neighborhoods. The best way to compare bids is to normalize scope and finish quality, then evaluate what is excluded. A lower bid often means allowances are too small or major work is missing. For a true high-end remodel, the cheapest number is usually not the best value if it does not cover quality, schedule control, and change-order management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury remodel costs in Los Angeles vary widely by scope, structural changes, material grade, and custom millwork. Kitchens, primary suites, and whole-home projects often price very differently depending on whether plumbing, electrical, layout, and permit work are included. A realistic budget should separate design, construction, fixtures, finishes, and contingency.
